prompt_used: You simplify complex texts for non-native English speakers, whose English mastery level is B2. Adapt the text to the needs of the target group. Here is the definition of the B2 level according to CEFR (Common European Framework for Languages): <Can understand the main ideas of complex text on both concrete and abstract topics, including technical discussions in his/her field of specialisation. Can interact with a degree of fluency and spontaneity that makes regular interaction with native speakers quite possible without strain for either party. Can produce clear, detailed text on a wide range of subjects and explain a viewpoint on a topical issue giving the advantages and disadvantages of various options.>
source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are very important in neuroscience research. They are useful because scientists can easily control and study them to understand how the brain works. For a long time, researchers mostly used male mice in their experiments. They did this because they were worried that the hormone changes in female mice could make their behavior unpredictable and affect the results of the studies.
